title: Move the operative tick contract into the always-loaded operating block
action: Per T1 move the OPERATIVE tick contract from skills/bee-hive/references/routing-and-contracts.md:238-303 into packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md. The clauses that move: every perceivable pipeline step emits exactly ONE short chat line, on by default; no bypass level at any tier ever silences a tick, and a red or refusal is never silence-able; the fixed format `<glyph> <event>: <what> - <key fact>`; the four-row glyph table; and both silence switches named -- `quiet` in .bee/config.json silences the tick stream but never the red line, and ship_visibility governs only the two PR-related ticks. Per T2 the 24-row worked-example CATALOG STAYS in the reference: it is examples, not the contract, and at ~3.9K it cannot fit. Leave the reference section coherent after the move -- it keeps the catalog and points at the block for the rule, rather than being left as an orphaned table. Per T3 pay for the new bytes by REMOVING bytes from the block. Do NOT raise WARN_BYTES (14000) or HARD_FAIL_BYTES (15000) in scripts/tests/test_agents_budget.mjs. The block is 12692 bytes today; the contract is roughly 1850, so roughly 550 bytes must come out to stay under the warn line. Hunt genuine redundancy: a sentence the surrounding rule already implies, a pointer to a reference whose rule is now stated in full, historical rationale that no longer changes behavior. Per T7 every prose token pinned by scripts/tests/test_gate_bypass_doctrine.mjs and packages/bee/tests/test_misc.mjs's census must survive verbatim, and the rule roster stays contiguous -- if the contract lands as its own rule rather than folded into rule 10, move EXPECTED_RULE_COUNT in this same cell. Never hand-edit root AGENTS.md: edit the template and re-render with node packages/bee/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply. Also update skills/bee-hive/SKILL.md:120 so its pointer reflects that the rule now lives in the block.
